patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Klaviyo and Moosend share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Comparison thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Klaviyo only if your buying job matches “Ecommerce email + SMS platform with Shopify-native flows, revenue attribution, and active-” rather than Moosend's shape. Choose Moosend only if your buying job matches “Budget-friendly email automation ESP with contact-tier Pro pricing and unlimited sends.” rather than Klaviyo's shape. Workflow advantage: Klaviyo leans ecommerce-email; Moosend leans shared coverage. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Klaviyo and Moosend share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Klaviyo is Ecommerce email + SMS platform with Shopify-native flows, revenue attribution, and active-profile billing.; Moosend is Budget-friendly email automation ESP with contact-tier Pro pricing and unlimited sends..
- Company-size focus: Klaviyo (small-business, mid-market, enterprise) vs Moosend (micro, small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: Klaviyo-leaning ecommerce-email vs Moosend-leaning —.
- Researched limits: Klaviyo — Active-profile billing can rise quickly as the store’s engaged customer base grows; Moosend — No forever-free plan — trial-only entry.

Limitations — Klaviyo: Active-profile billing can rise quickly as the store’s engaged customer base grows; Exact paid-band dollars require the live pricing slider — floors are research estimates; Moosend: No forever-free plan — trial-only entry; Exact contact-tier dollars require the live calculator.

Poor-fit cases: Klaviyo is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Active-profile billing can rise quickly as the store’s engaged customer base grows · Moosend is a poor fit when that limitation bites: No forever-free plan — trial-only entry · Avoid Klaviyo if you actually need Moosend's motion (Budget-friendly email automation ESP with contact-tier Pro pricing and unlimited)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
